t: An FPGA board with a Linux computer inside that you control from Python notebooks.
steps: Buy the PYNQ-Z2 through the AMD University Program, DigiKey or DFRobot. Prices seen range from 129 to 259 US dollars.
Get a microSD card, a micro USB cable and a network cable.
Download the PYNQ-Z2 image from the PYNQ website.
Flash the image to the microSD card with a free image writing app.
Plug in the card and the network cable, then power up the board.
Open Jupyter in your web browser and log in.
Run the base overlay notebook and blink the LEDs.
meta: Open Board. From $129. A few stores.
